title: Errors and warnings
description: Errors and warnings of the backend's log files, grouped by message (Loki, shipped by progeo-alloy).

links.title: Generate Agent-Report
links.tooltip: Downloads a zip with report.json (the server's state of the last 24 hours) and PROMPT.md (instructions for a coding agent).

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: ERROR and CRITICAL lines in the selected range. Counted once: errors.jsonl (every WARNING+ of the Python loggers) plus the lines other programs write (supervisord, uvicorn, shell output). The copies of the same records in backend.err.log and celery*.log are left out.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="progeo-backend", level=~"ERROR|CRITICAL", file=~"$file"} !~ "^[[][0-9-]+ [0-9:]+[]] [[][A-Za-z_.]+[]] [[]" !~ "^ ?[0-9:.]+ +[[][A-Z]+[]]" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Errors, period before
panels.description: The same count for the equally long period before the selected range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="progeo-backend", level=~"ERROR|CRITICAL", file=~"$file"} !~ "^[[][0-9-]+ [0-9:]+[]] [[][A-Za-z_.]+[]] [[]" !~ "^ ?[0-9:.]+ +[[][A-Z]+[]]" [$__range] offset $__range)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Different errors
panels.description: Error messages that differ in more than numbers and ids.

panels.title: Latest errors
panels.description: Newest first, with the traceback where the logger recorded one. Counted once: errors.jsonl (every WARNING+ of the Python loggers) plus the lines other programs write (supervisord, uvicorn, shell output). The copies of the same records in backend.err.log and celery*.log are left out.

targets.expr:
{job="progeo-backend", level=~"ERROR|CRITICAL", file=~"$file"} !~ "^[[][0-9-]+ [0-9:]+[]] [[][A-Za-z_.]+[]] [[]" !~ "^ ?[0-9:.]+ +[[][A-Z]+[]]" | json | drop __error__, __error_details__ | line_format `{{ if .message }}[{{ .logger }}] {{ .message }}  ({{ .process }}){{ if .exception }}
{{ .exception }}{{ end }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}`
